verdict.rationale: Cerebras offers official Python (pip install cerebras_cloud_sdk) and Node/TypeScript SDKs, OpenAI-compatible APIs enabling near-drop-in migration, quickstart docs, streaming, tool-use, structured outputs, and vision support, with community reports confirming real-world SDK/agent integrations (e.g., coding agents, Cursor support). missing for 10: independent OpenAPI/schema spec discovery (probe found openapi.json 404s), broader third-party SDK ecosystem coverage beyond Node/Python, and more extensive hands-on validation of SDK edge cases.
